stories.title: Company denies allegation nurse contract not being renewed over Poilievre photo
stories.summary: The employer of a nurse who Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre says has been told her contract won’t be renewed over a photo with him says the allegations are false.

stories.title: Court strikes down First Nation’s challenge of Alberta sovereignty act
stories.summary: The judge said the Onion Lake's claim made statements without supporting facts or by using hypotheticals about use of the sovereignty act — which could not be argued in court.

stories.title: The engineering feat at the heart of Canada’s next big Arctic build
stories.summary: The road – about 10 metres wide for traffic in both directions – will traverse low-lying tundra and a maze of lakes, ponds and streams, requiring about 230 bridges and culverts.

stories.title: A road through Nunavut: The monumental billion-dollar plan to connect Canada’s Arctic
stories.summary: The all-season road would be the first to go across Nunavut, stretching 230 km. from N.W.T. to Grays Bay — where Canada would have its first deepsea port on the western Arctic.

stories.title: Project to increase Trans Mountain pipeline flows starts up ahead of schedule
stories.summary: A further expansion of 210,000 barrels per day is expected to come into service by the end of 2028, bringing the system's total capacity to 1.19 billion barrels a day.

stories.title: School bus catches fire, rolls onto railway tracks in St. Albert
stories.summary: St. Albert RCMP said officers were called over the noon hour Thursday to a school bus fire near Leclair Way and Sir Winston Churchill Avenue.

stories.title: Alberta expecting $18B budget turnaround propelled by oil royalties
stories.summary: In the 2022-23 fiscal year, the province took in a record $25 billion in resource revenues, but the province expects to break that with almost $29 billion this year.

stories.title: Funding future for Calgary’s Foothills Fieldhouse questioned during budget talks
stories.summary: A lack of funding commitments from other orders of government has some Calgary city councillors considering reallocating funding for the Foothills Fieldhouse to other priorities.

stories.title: McGuinty investigating after Poilievre said nurse’s job threatened over photo
stories.summary: Poilievre said his privilege as a MP was breached when a nurse was told she might lose her job after she was photographed speaking with him at the Wainwright base.

stories.title: B.C. Lions want to own or operate home stadium
stories.summary: B.C. Lions owner Amar Doman says the CFL team is interested in owning or operating BC Place, its home stadium in Vancouver.
